entries.what: The Supabase Management API logs.all analytics endpoint is removed and answers 410 Gone.

source.quote: The `logs.all` Management API endpoint is being removed on 23rd September 2026 (Wednesday), two months from this announcement.

lookFor: A request to .../analytics/endpoints/logs.all on api.supabase.com. Exclude logs.all elsewhere, such as a self-hosted Logflare /endpoints/query/logs.all or an app's own logs.all().
requires: Convert the SQL to the ClickHouse dialect: the new endpoint accepts nothing else.
Query the one logs table and filter by source_name in the WHERE clause, instead of selecting a source table such as edge_logs.
Nested fields move from the metadata array to a flat log_attributes map, so the CROSS JOIN unnest() joins go away.
The range is at most 24 hours, and only the last minute is queried without iso_timestamp_start and iso_timestamp_end.
A repo that pins @supabase/mcp-server-supabase needs v0.10.0 or later: its get_logs tool called logs.all.
